title: Towards Transparent Reward Design in Clinical Reinforcement Learning
description: Using automated insulin dosing as a testbed, we show that conventionally trained policies occupy one such undisclosed point on a tradeoff surface, producing clinically consequential failure modes invisible to standard metrics. We construct an approximate Pareto frontier through preference-conditioned RL and show that it recovers policies with similar aggregate performance but different risk profiles across three simulated patients.
